limitations: Several forced contrasts or descriptive restatements.

Run after the four interleaved conditions, so its timing comparison is less controlled.

overall: No return to a repeated production-memory explanation was observed in these replays with the revised prompt. This is mainly evidence for the prompt change, not proof that shortening the context caused it.
The facts-only prose and cards contain the same sentences and order; the screen does not establish a general benefit from headings or removal of chronology.
A higher temperature changes samples, not reliably their semantic novelty. Errors of objects and actors occur at every tested temperature.
The compact 0.3 preset is a practical operating choice: comparable overall readings, fewer context tokens and lower observed response time. The full narrative remains a valid alternative.
